Indicators: Low thermal_state_index, falling hot metal temperature, low predicted Si
Typical operator considerations: Avoid overcooling, restore heat input gradually
Advisory action pattern: Reduce wind slightly, reduce PCI, raise coke and oxygen enrichment, increase blast temp if available

Indicators: High thermal_state_index, rising Si, high hot metal temperature
Typical operator considerations: Avoid excess fuel and high silicon, protect productivity
Advisory action pattern: Increase wind modestly, raise PCI/substitute coke, reduce coke, reduce oxygen enrichment if needed

Indicators: High pressure drop, low permeability index, tuyere blockage, unstable descent
Typical operator considerations: Stabilize gas flow before pushing production
Advisory action pattern: Reduce wind, reduce PCI, increase coke support, raise top pressure, shift burden distribution toward center coke

Indicators: Si or S moving outside target range
Typical operator considerations: Use small controlled trims; avoid chasing noise
Advisory action pattern: Small fuel/oxygen trim; validate lab delay and sensor status
